mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days. Higher rates compress equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to lower returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) above 0.5 percentage points signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) drives returns. When FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE is falling, it indicates tightening with improving labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant, as measured by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (measured as the 3-month change in CPIAUCSL) above 0.5 points signals high inflation, triggering market anticipation of rate cuts and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, associated with rising wages and inflation, but also strong economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) drives returns. When INDPRO is declining and HOUST is rising, it indicates a supply shock in manufacturing with strong housing demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant, as measured by a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1400) signals strong demand for housing, a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing, associated with economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
